info.name: h2oGPTe REST Document Ingestion API
Document Ingestion
upload_file

items.docs: Uploads file to H2OGPTe instance

info.name: Ingest uploaded document

params.name: upload_ids
params.description: Id of uploaded document

params.name: collection_id
params.description: String id of the collection to add the ingested documents into.

params.name: gen_doc_summaries
params.description: Whether to auto-generate document summaries (uses LLM).

params.name: gen_doc_questions
params.description: Whether to auto-generate sample questions for each document (uses LLM).

params.name: audio_input_language
params.description: Language of audio files.

params.name: ocr_model
params.description: Which method to use to extract text from images using AI-enabled optical character recognition (OCR) models. docTR is best for Latin text, PaddleOCR is best for certain non-Latin languages, Tesseract covers a wide range of languages. Mississippi works well on handwriting. - `auto` - Automatic will auto-select the best OCR model for every page. - `off` - Disable OCR for speed, but all images will then be skipped (also no image captions will be made).

params.name: tesseract_lang
params.description: Which language to use when using ocr_model="tesseract".

params.name: keep_tables_as_one_chunk
params.description: When tables are identified by the table parser the table tokens will be kept in a single chunk.

params.name: chunk_by_page
params.description: Each page will be a chunk. `keep_tables_as_one_chunk` will be ignored if this is `true`.

params.name: handwriting_check
params.description: Check pages for handwriting. Will use specialized models if handwriting is found.

params.name: ingest_mode
params.description: Ingest mode to use. - `standard` - Files will be ingested for use with RAG - `agent_only` - Bypasses standard ingestion. Files can only be used with agents.

params.name: restricted
params.description: Whether the document should be restricted only to certain users.

params.name: permissions
params.description: The list of usernames having permissions to the document.

params.name: encrypt_document
params.description: Whether to encrypt the document files at rest in object storage.

params.name: timeout
params.description: Timeout in seconds

info.name: Crawls and ingest a URL into a collection.

params.name: collection_id
params.description: String id of the collection to add the ingested documents into.

params.name: follow_links
params.description: Whether to import all web pages linked from this URL will be imported. External links will be ignored. Links to other pages on the same domain will be followed as long as they are at the same level or below the URL you specify. Each page will be transformed into a PDF document.

params.name: max_depth
params.description: Max depth of recursion when following links, only when follow_links is `true`. Max_depth of 0 means don't follow any links, max_depth of 1 means follow only top-level links, etc. Use -1 for automatic (system settings).

params.name: max_documents
params.description: Max number of documents when following links, only when follow_links is `true`. Use None for automatic (system defaults). Use -1 for max (system limit).

params.name: gen_doc_summaries
params.description: Whether to auto-generate document summaries (uses LLM).

params.name: gen_doc_questions
params.description: Whether to auto-generate sample questions for each document (uses LLM).

params.name: audio_input_language
params.description: Language of audio files.

params.name: ocr_model
params.description: Which method to use to extract text from images using AI-enabled optical character recognition (OCR) models. docTR is best for Latin text, PaddleOCR is best for certain non-Latin languages, Tesseract covers a wide range of languages. Mississippi works well on handwriting. - `auto` - Automatic will auto-select the best OCR model for every page. - `off` - Disable OCR for speed, but all images will then be skipped (also no image captions will be made).

params.name: tesseract_lang
params.description: Which language to use when using ocr_model="tesseract".

params.name: keep_tables_as_one_chunk
params.description: When tables are identified by the table parser the table tokens will be kept in a single chunk.

params.name: chunk_by_page
params.description: Each page will be a chunk. `keep_tables_as_one_chunk` will be ignored if this is `true`.

params.name: ingest_mode
params.description: Ingest mode to use. - `standard` - Files will be ingested for use with RAG - `agent_only` - Bypasses standard ingestion. Files can only be used with agents.

params.name: timeout

Adds files from Microsoft SharePoint Online into a collection. Accepts a
list of entries — sites, drives, folders, or files — each identified by
the drive_id and object_id returned by the connector browse API.

To ingest from a drive that is only addressable by its drive_id (for
example a OneDrive personal drive, a Microsoft 365 group drive, or any
drive in a non-discoverable site) pass an entry with
entry_type="drive_by_id" and the drive_id field set.
